messages:
Jade (partnerships): Quick heads-up — OrionCloud pushed a partial manifest update: OC-RK-48 shows 12 racks delayed, ETA bumped ~10 days. This touches Dedicated reservations and one marketplace listing. Can we triage reallocation? @Tony, can you confirm reasons?
Tony (OrionCloud): Sorry about this. Shipping carrier had a dock miscount, manifests corrected this morning. Delay is for specific lot numbers (OC-2024-Q3). We're processing an expedited re-route. ETA +9–11 days.
Sana (logistics): If it's 12 racks, that's ~48 GPUs. Which reserved pools are impacted? Matt, do you have the reservation mapping?
Matt (capacity): Looks like 32 GPUs are already allocated to the 'ACME' Dedicated commit (region-us-west) and 16 are in marketplace buffer. If we can't reassign, ACME will drop below SLA on start-of-month baseline.
Emily (sales): @Matt can we swap from the marketplace buffer for ACME? They signed a clause for priority reassignments but need confirmation today.
Matt (capacity): We can cover ACME by pulling 16 from marketplace buffer + 16 from an upcoming inbound from ByteCloud if ByteCloud's manifest holds. That leaves marketplace at ~60% of target.
Jade (partnerships): Okay — plan A: Tony to confirm which lot numbers will route to us in the expedited shipment. Plan B: if not, we reassign marketplace -> ACME and flag marketplace customers (low-touch) with a 48h notice. @Sam, any compliance notice needed for marketplace realloc?
Sam (legal): Reallocation is covered under the marketplace T&Cs but we need to notify affected marketplace customers with the specific SKU and revised ETA. Keep message factual: SKU, order id, new ETA window. No refunds unless committed.
Tony (OrionCloud): Confirmed manifest excerpt:
```
SKU,LOT,STATUS,ETA
OC-RK-48,OC-2024-Q3-12,DELAYED,2026-04-21 to 2026-04-23
OC-RK-48,OC-2024-Q3-13,ON_SCHEDULE,2026-04-12
```
We'll push a new ASN by EOD. Expedited routing for lot 13 is inbound.
Sana (logistics): Good. @Matt I'll tentatively reserve 16 from ByteCloud inbound and hold marketplace pool 0 for 24h while we confirm ASN. If ASN for lot13 lands, we keep marketplace intact.
Matt (capacity): Marking change in the reservation sheet and the internal slack channel #release-war-room. I'll also set a fallback policy to scale Dedicated burst to spare capacity if manifest slips.
Emily (sales): I'll draft the marketplace customer notice and ping support + ops for the 48h notify if we reassign.
Jade (partnerships): Thanks all. Tony please post the ASN link when it's live. If we need to flip allocations I'll post a short update to partners@redwood and tag sales/escalations. :thumbsup: 
orion-integrations-bot: ASN uploaded: https://orioncloud.example/asn/OC-2024-Q3-13
Tony (OrionCloud): ASN here ^ — lot13 confirmed, should cover ACME if it clears customs by 4/12. Will update if anything else changes.
Sana (logistics): Noted. I'll start customs clearance check and share ETA variance if >48h.
Jade (partnerships): Closing loop — Matt to confirm final allocation by 12:00 PT. If no blockers, no marketplace reassign. Otherwise execute plan to notify marketplace customers.
Matt (capacity): Got it — will confirm by noon PT.
Jade (partnerships): Thanks team, appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
